Cleaning for the places you run

Pick your building type — every plan is built around your space, your schedule, and the areas your customers and staff notice most.

Offices

For offices, law firms, real estate, and professional spaces that need to look sharp every morning.

  • Desks, workstations & common areas
  • Restrooms cleaned & restocked
  • Trash, recycling & break rooms
  • Floors vacuumed & mopped
  • Glass, doors & high-touch points

Clinics & Medical

For dental, medical, PT, chiropractic, and vet clinics where clean is part of patient trust.

  • Waiting rooms & exam rooms
  • High-touch disinfection throughout
  • Restrooms sanitized & restocked
  • Floors, glass & reception areas
  • Trash & biohazard-bin areas (exterior)

Gyms & Fitness

For gyms and training studios where members judge you on locker rooms and equipment.

  • Equipment & high-touch disinfection
  • Locker rooms & showers detailed
  • Floors — turf, rubber & tile
  • Mirrors, glass & front desk
  • Restrooms cleaned & restocked

Also available: move-in / move-out cleans, post-construction cleanup, deep cleans, and one-time cleans. Call to ask →

What every visit includes — and what it costs

No vague promises. Here’s the standard checklist, and a real example price so you know where you stand before you call.

Standard on every visit

  • Trash emptied & liners replaced
  • Restrooms cleaned & restocked
  • Floors vacuumed & mopped
  • Desks & surfaces wiped
  • High-touch points disinfected
  • Break room / kitchen wiped down
  • Glass & entry doors spot-cleaned
  • Final walk-through check

Need more — floor scrubbing, carpet care, windows, or a deep clean? We’ll add it to your plan at your walkthrough.

About Legacy

Legacy Commercial Cleaning is owner-operated by Legend Thompson. That means the person you talk to is the person responsible for your clean — vetted local crews, backup coverage when you need it, and a single number to call for anything.

Common questions

Do I have to sign a long contract?

No. We start simple — agree your plan and price, pay the first month up front, and earn your business every visit.

What if my regular cleaner can’t make it?

We arrange backup coverage so your clean still happens on schedule. That’s the whole point of Legacy — you never have to chase it.

How is billing handled?

Simple and up front: your first month (or deposit) is paid before service starts, then monthly up front after that. One clear price, no surprise fees.

Do you bring supplies and equipment?

Yes — crews arrive with the supplies and equipment for your checklist. Restroom paper and soap restocking can be included in your plan.

How fast can we start?

After your free 15-minute walkthrough and your upfront payment, we schedule your first clean — usually within the week, depending on your area and frequency.
